abstract_message_control.component: C=K2 with both vertices having base list [4].
abstract_message_control.three_color_scope: If all dynamic complete-neighbors of C are restricted to colors {1,2,3}, then the unique maximal bad event is F={1,2,3}.
abstract_message_control.semantic_constraint: colors(D_C) must not contain all three colors 1,2,3.
abstract_message_control.interpretation: For a 3-uniform D_C={x,y,z}, this is exactly a no-rainbow hyperedge constraint.

hardness_firewall.important_correction: No-rainbow hyperedge constraints alone are not an NP-hard decision problem if arbitrary non-surjective colorings are allowed; a monochromatic coloring satisfies all constraints.
imported_NP_complete_forms: No Rainbow Hypergraph 3-Coloring with fixed-color vertex sets A1,A2,A3.
hardness_firewall.gate_requirement: Any hardness-localization promotion must source-embed one of these complete contracts, not merely the local K2 no-rainbow relation.

frozen_source_target.input_language: Prefer the fixed-color-set NP-complete formulation on a 3-uniform hypergraph H=(V,E) with A1,A2,A3.
frozen_source_target.variable_survivors: one survivor x_v per hypergraph vertex v, intended to lie in one fixed B0 coarse class sigma with source list {1,2,3}.
frozen_source_target.hyperedge_components: for every e={u,v,w} create one residual Y0 component C_e=K2, complete exactly to x_u,x_v,x_w among variable survivors.
frozen_source_target.fixed_color_anchor_candidate: Use source-semantic X0 anchoring to force x_v=k for v in A_k while preserving its source L_P/coarse-class coordinates, because X0 constrains actual extensions but does not define source L_P. This is only a candidate mechanism and must be source-verified.
frozen_source_target.fourth_color_exclusion: All variable survivors must have source/actual availability restricted to colors {1,2,3}; color 4 must be excluded by exact source structure without breaking the one-sigma requirement.
frozen_source_target.hard_VI_control: Add only a constant source-valid second 3-list class/residual component if needed to keep axiom (vi) false, without changing any C_e message.

exact_obligations: one fixed B0 coarse sigma for all hypergraph variable survivors
exact fixed-color anchoring for A1,A2,A3 or an exact surjectivity gadget
all C_e remain connected residual Y0 K2 components
axiom (iv) complete/anticomplete incidence exactly realizes the hyperedges
P7-freeness of the entire graph for arbitrary input hypergraph instances in the chosen NP-hard source class
hard post-seed-two VI state remains active

PASS_SOURCE_NO_RAINBOW_EMBEDDING.meaning: An exact polynomial reduction from an NP-complete fixed-color/surjective no-rainbow 3-coloring language into the frozen source hard state is proved.
PASS_SOURCE_NO_RAINBOW_EMBEDDING.consequence: Joint component-message composition contains an NP-complete core inside the exact source grammar.
PASS_SOURCE_NO_RAINBOW_EMBEDDING.ceiling: This localizes P-vs-NP-scale difficulty; it does not prove P!=NP and does not rule out a polynomial algorithm unless P!=NP.

BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE_OR_P7_LAW.meaning: The first exact source/P7 obligation preventing arbitrary no-rainbow composition is identified.
BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE_OR_P7_LAW.consequence: Promote that obstruction as the next structural compression theorem target.

OPEN_SOURCE_NO_RAINBOW_EMBEDDING.meaning: Neither exact embedding nor exact obstruction is proved.

anti_duplication: Do not count the K2 relation alone as an NP-hard language.
Do not omit surjectivity/fixed-color anchoring from the hardness contract.
Do not use finite message alphabet as a tractability claim.
Do not write a new solver before the source embedding question is resolved.
Reuse B1B1C0 compiled message tables and existing exact-interface adequacy standards.
